arch_opening: There is an update available — version 1.5.0. It's a small quality-of-life one: slash commands. Instead of pasting the session prompt every time, you type /architect — that's the whole thing. I'll check your setup and add the command files if you want them.

changes.title: Slash commands — /architect and /tmt-setup
changes.what_changed: Two command files now ship in .claude/commands/ with every install. /architect starts or resumes the Architect session — it reads manifest.md to find the role file, follows Session Start, and optionally takes the Project Owner's first request as an argument (/architect fix the login bug). /tmt-setup runs first-time setup. Both are role-neutral, so renamed teams need no edits.
changes.old_behavior: Every session started by pasting a multi-line boot prompt: 'You are the Architect on this project. Read [project file], then ARCHITECT.md.'
changes.new_behavior: Type /architect. The command routes through manifest.md to the right role file regardless of team names.
changes.user_impact_plain: Starting a session goes from pasting two lines you had to keep somewhere to typing one word.
changes.how_to_assess: Check whether .claude/commands/architect.md and .claude/commands/tmt-setup.md exist in the project root. If not: after the user updates their framework clone (git pull), copy templates/project-folder/.claude/commands/ into the project's .claude/commands/. If the clone is not available, fetch the two raw files from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudaipro/three-man-team/main/templates/project-folder/.claude/commands/ . No edits needed for renamed teams — the commands are role-neutral. If the user renamed their team and wants a command matching the custom name, copy architect.md to <name>.md.
changes.user_decision: Want me to add the /architect and /tmt-setup commands to this project? From then on you start every session by typing /architect.

changes.title: Checkpoint Resume Prompt leads with /architect
changes.what_changed: The SESSION-CHECKPOINT.md template's Resume Prompt section now says 'Type /architect to resume' with the classic paste prompt kept as manual fallback.
changes.old_behavior: Resume Prompt only offered the multi-line paste prompt.
changes.new_behavior: Resume is one word; the paste prompt remains for tools without slash commands.
changes.user_impact_plain: Resuming after a break is /architect — the checkpoint gets picked up automatically by Session Start.
changes.how_to_assess: Read the user's handoff/SESSION-CHECKPOINT.md Resume Prompt section. If it only shows the paste prompt, offer to update the phrasing to lead with /architect. Only applies if they took the slash-commands change above.
changes.user_decision: Want me to update your checkpoint's Resume Prompt to lead with /architect?
